description: Register a new API key by paying a one-time fee. Pay the registration fee (see get_server_info) from the Cardano address you want your key bound to, sending it to the operator's payment_address, then call this with that transaction's hash. The payment must already be CONFIRMED on-chain (wait ~20-30s after submitting, or check with check_payment_status). One active key per address -- registering twice with the same address fails. Each payment transaction can only be used once, for registration or for a mint, not both.
name: register
